name: Project Notes
description: Tasks, prompts and ideas per project, with one-tap prompt pills, a launcher that shows each started agent on its task, and an agent CLI. English and Simplified Chinese plus user-defined languages.

zh-CN.name: 拾页 · 项目手记
zh-CN.description: 按项目记录任务、提示词和想法：一键发送的提示词胶囊，从任务启动 Agent 并在任务卡上显示它的状态，另附给 Agent 用的命令行工具。支持英文、简体中文和用户自定义语言。
